About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) is a public sector undertaking of the Government of Uttar Pradesh that operates bus services in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India.
The UPSRTC is responsible for providing efficient and affordable transportation services to the people of Uttar Pradesh.

About the Programme

The UPSRTC Bus Conductor Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for Indian citizens to work as bus conductors in various districts of Uttar Pradesh.
The programme aims to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates and improve the transportation services in the state.
